entities.name: Genuin Monetize
entities.description: Unified platform that empowers brands, publishers, and retail/community media networks to unlock new revenue streams through video monetization across owned (Onsite) and partner (Offsite) inventory.

entities.name: Sponsored Content
entities.description: Monetization solution that directly integrates branded posts and takeovers as premium native video experiences.

entities.name: Programmatic Advertising
entities.description: Leverages both open and direct programmatic demand to deliver in-feed/in-stream video ads at scale.

entities.name: IAB-Compatible Audience Extension
entities.description: Uses industry-standard IAB ad units to extend reach and monetize audience extension programmatically across partner sites.

entities.name: Onsite Monetization
entities.description: Monetization on a customer's owned and operated digital properties through integrated sponsored content and programmatic video ads.

entities.name: Offsite Monetization
entities.description: Extends monetization beyond owned channels by tapping into trusted partner inventory within the Genuin network for audience extension.

entities.name: Onsite Sponsored Content
entities.description: Converts direct sponsor demand into premium, native video experiences on a customer's owned properties, e.g. a retailer running a brand's sponsored post within product detail pages.

entities.name: Onsite Programmatic
entities.description: Optimizes yield with programmatic in-feed/in-stream video ads to fill and scale revenue on owned sites, e.g. a publisher maximizing ad revenue through automated placements.

entities.name: Onsite IAB Extension
entities.description: Drives quality audience extension with IAB-compatible units, replacing low-value content widgets, e.g. a media brand using IAB banners to offer sponsored content slots within its network.

entities.name: Offsite Sponsored Content
entities.description: Scales direct sponsor campaigns by placing branded content on trusted partner inventory, e.g. a CPG brand distributing its sponsored video campaign across a network of relevant brands.

entities.name: Offsite IAB Extension
entities.description: Expands reach and monetizes audience extension programmatically using portable IAB units across a programmatic exchange of partner sites.

entities.name: Brand Direct Sponsorships
entities.description: High-touch direct sponsorship sales channel supported within the unified Monetize platform alongside programmatic demand.

entities.name: Genuin Network
entities.description: Network of trusted partner inventory that powers Offsite audience extension and distribution of sponsored campaigns.

entities.name: Brands
entities.description: Enterprise advertisers who use Monetize to run sponsored content and programmatic campaigns onsite and offsite.

entities.name: Publishers
entities.description: Media publishers who use Monetize to fill and scale video ad revenue on their owned properties.

entities.name: Retail Media Networks
entities.description: Retail and community media network operators who monetize their digital properties via Genuin Monetize.

entities.name: CPG Brands
entities.description: Consumer packaged goods advertisers cited as an example user distributing sponsored video campaigns across the Genuin partner network.

entities.name: Large Retailers
entities.description: Large retailers cited as an example use case running sponsored posts within their product detail pages.

entities.name: Media Brands
entities.description: Media brands cited as an example use case using IAB banners to offer sponsored content slots within their networks.

entities.name: Native Video Experiences
entities.description: Genuin's native video formats that maintain high engagement while delivering monetization without disrupting the user journey.

entities.name: Control & Transparency
entities.description: Granular control over placements, targeting, pricing, and analytics to align campaigns with brand values and performance objectives.

entities.name: IAB Standards
entities.description: Industry-standard IAB ad unit specifications that Genuin's audience extension units are compatible with for broader programmatic reach.

Monetize supports high-touch Brand Direct sponsorships within its unified platform.
Monetize delivers monetization via Genuin's native video experiences that preserve engagement.
Monetize provides granular control and transparency over placements, targeting, pricing, and analytics.

Monetize is designed for publishers monetizing video inventory on owned properties.
Monetize is designed for retail and community media networks.
